description:
An API the brain calls (`apis/*.yaml` → `(:ApiContext)`): where it is and
how it authenticates. The secret stays in env; only its variable's name
is stored.

env_props.description: Node property → env var, set from the environment at every start.

kind.description: Its data kind (`apis/_kinds.yaml`), set when the node is created.

retire_exempt.description:
Used outside workflows (a search engine behind `search_web`, GitHub
behind the developer tools), so never offered for retirement for going
unused. Set from the file on every start.

topics.description: The topics it serves, set when the node is created.

title: ApiContextFile
